body.prose:
The field has no single hierarchy. In the store every holon stands flat, an id and its version; order and nesting live only in bodies, in a brief's parts, a lone link. So the root is no holon of the field's own making but a mount: what the reader is looking at, held as data. Glass ships one as its entry, giving everything, grouped by what splits it best, and a holarchy such as this wiki is entered from there, like anything else.

The primitives themselves are still: they hold no state, take no press and move nowhere. Looking around is something built on them, and the one thing it needs to stand still to be changed is the root mount, so that is where it lives, as [§8](ref:01M6GXP144V8HNCWWR3HP6TEV0) tells.

*The author's, [2026-11-03](ref:01M6GXP142MQFYEW77T03MHTFP): there is no state, no interaction and no navigation in the primitives, and that is something to birth upon them; the root should be an actual reading, not a custom component. That the entry once stood at the field itself as a projection, drawn by a component of its own, is let go in it.*
body.title: The root is a mount
